input: A commit that modifies any /moves/<agent>.text or /turn/ply.num must be signed by the moving piece and by at least twelve of the sixteen Black agents' keys in /team/pieces/, so no piece can play an off-plan move by signing alone.
response: always([+modifies(/moves/$k.text) -signed_by(/team/pieces/$k.id)] false) & always([+modifies(/moves/$k.text) -threshold("12", /team/pieces)] false) & always([+modifies(/turn/ply.num) -threshold("12", /team/pieces)] false)
